notes: The source page is the Airframe & Powerplant, Certificate of Achievement (Banner 1_CF_AMAP, Control Number 22392). It is not the Powerplant, Certificate of Achievement named in the request. The Powerplant certificate appears only as a link in the site menu.

The A&P certificate requires 17 courses totaling 63 units. That exceeds the requested award's 30 to fewer than 60 unit range. It also includes airframe courses not in the closed list: AMT A152, A160, A161, A162, A163 and A181.
The closed list sums to 40 units: the general courses A150, A151, A153, A154 and A155, the powerplant courses A170 to A174, and A180. This is consistent with a separate Powerplant certificate.

No blocks, outcomes or careers were recorded, because they belong to the A&P certificate rather than this award. A reviewer should locate the Powerplant certificate page, likely .../powerplant-certificate-achievement/.
For reference, the A&P page prints two program learning outcomes and names the career 'Airframe and Powerplant Certificated Mechanics' plus related fields.
